# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/omni3d
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/omni3d

## File: facebookresearch_omni3d/cubercnn/evaluation/omni3d_evaluation.py

Prompts

```
['run Omni3DEvaluationHelper to evaluate 3D object detection predictions across multiple Omni3D dataset splits', 'create an Omni3DEvaluator instance to collect and evaluate 2D and 3D bounding box predictions on a dataset', 'run Omni3Deval to compute 2D or 3D IoU-based average precision metrics for object detection results', 'compute 3D bounding box IoU overlap between detection and ground truth boxes using box3d_overlap', 'run inference_on_dataset to benchmark model predictions and collect results from a data loader']
```

Usage

```
{'run_Omni3DEvaluationHelper': 'run Omni3DEvaluationHelper to evaluate 3D object detection predictions across multiple Omni3D dataset splits', 'create_Omni3DEvaluator': 'create an Omni3DEvaluator instance to collect and evaluate 2D and 3D bounding box predictions on a dataset', 'run_Omni3Deval': 'run Omni3Deval to compute 2D or 3D IoU-based average precision metrics for object detection results', 'compute_box3d_overlap': 'compute 3D bounding box IoU overlap between detection and ground truth boxes using box3d_overlap', 'run_inference_on_dataset': 'run inference_on_dataset to benchmark model predictions and collect results from a data loader'}
```
